caption: Murano canal, Venice
composition: Quiet Murano canal with arched bridge and campanile · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks down the canal from the near bank, weathered rose-red houses lining the left with moored boats under blue covers in the foreground, while the brick arch bridge spans the water at the center and the tall campanile rises behind it. More houses and masts fill the right bank, and the canal water mirrors the whole scene. At 10:11 the light is bright and clear, and the street is quiet.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of a Murano canal under morning light
